label: Personal Belongings
labelVi: Đồ dùng cá nhân mang theo

examples.en: She put her notebook and water bottle into her canvas bag.

passages.title: Organizing Everyday Belongings for a Busy Commute
passages.titleVi: Sắp xếp đồ dùng cá nhân hàng ngày cho chuyến đi bận rộn
passages.text: Every weekday morning before leaving his university dorm room, Daniel prepares his essential personal belongings with meticulous care and patience. Because he travels through congested city traffic as an active urban cyclist, carrying unnecessary extra weight can make his morning commute exhausting. He lays his rugged denim jacket across the study chair and securely buttons each sleeve cuff to keep chilly morning wind out. Next, Daniel arranges the contents of his waterproof backpack in a coherent order so that critical items remain accessible without digging. He decides to devote the padded inner compartment entirely to his fragile laptop computer and compact digital reading tablet. Beside his electronics, he slots a silver cylindrical insulated flask filled with hot peppermint tea into the elastic side sleeve of the pack. In a zippered front pouch, Daniel secures a tiny plastic security badge required for electronic building authentication and contactless library entry. He also carefully packs a sturdy set of duplicate apartment keys so that he never risks being locked out after evening classes. Past experience taught him that casual disregard for small daily preparations can easily ruin an otherwise productive and important workday. Before zipping the bag shut, he takes a quick thoughtful browse through his handwritten checklist to verify that nothing vital is missing. He calmly fastens the ergonomic chest strap of his backpack, adjusting the nylon buckles for maximum shoulder comfort and stability. Whatever unforeseen challenging circumstance arises during his journey, possessing the right gear gives him total peace of mind and resilience. Developing this practical organizational competence transforms a rushed, chaotic early routine into a tranquil and confident start to the day. When our essential personal possessions are well protected and orderly, we navigate modern urban life with wonderful ease, safety, and freedom.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'cylindrical' có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai: /səˈlɪn.drɪ.kəl/. Lưu ý âm đầu là /s/ nhẹ, theo sau là âm ngắn /ɪ/ và đuôi /-kəl/ lướt nhẹ.
Từ 'authentication' là một từ đa âm tiết có trọng âm chính rơi vào âm tiết thứ tư: /ɑːˌθen.t̬əˈkeɪ.ʃən/. Chú ý âm đầu /ɑː/ hoặc /ɔː/, phụ âm xát vô thanh /θ/ và đuôi /-ʃən/ dứt khoát.
Từ 'coherent' có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai: /koʊˈhɪr.ənt/. Chú ý nguyên âm đôi /oʊ/ ở âm tiết đầu và nguyên âm /ɪr/ kết hợp phụ âm /h/ ở âm tiết nhấn.
Từ 'exhausting' có trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai: /ɪɡˈzɑː.stɪŋ/. Chữ 'x' ở đây được phát âm thành cụm phụ âm hữu thanh /ɡz/ do đứng trước nguyên âm có trọng âm.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why does Daniel avoid carrying excessive weight during his morning travel?
options: Because riding his bicycle through heavy urban traffic with heavy bags makes the commute exhausting.
Because his university dormitory rules prohibit carrying heavy backpacks into the building.
Because the padded compartment inside his bag cannot support heavy electronics.
Because his insulated tea flask might break under excessive mechanical pressure.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ: 'Because he travels through congested city traffic as an active urban cyclist, carrying unnecessary extra weight can make his morning commute exhausting' (Vì đạp xe qua dòng xe cộ đông đúc, việc mang vác nặng thừa thãi khiến quãng đường đi lại trở nên kiệt sức).

comprehensionQuestions.question: What item does Daniel store inside the small zippered front pouch of his backpack?
options: An electronic plastic security badge used for contactless building and library authentication.
A silver cylindrical insulated flask filled with hot peppermint herbal tea.
A set of duplicate keys meant for his family home in another province.
A fragile digital reading tablet wrapped in a thick wool cloth.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn chỉ rõ: 'In a zippered front pouch, Daniel secures a tiny plastic security badge required for electronic building authentication and contactless library entry' (Trong túi nhỏ phía trước, Daniel cất chiếc thẻ an ninh nhựa dùng để xác thực ra vào tòa nhà và thư viện).

comprehensionQuestions.question: How does Daniel verify that no essential personal belonging is forgotten before leaving?
options: He takes a quick, thoughtful browse through his handwritten checklist.
He empties the entire contents of his backpack onto the dorm room floor.
He asks his roommate to inspect the exterior pockets of his denim jacket.
He scans each item using a mobile inventory application on his phone.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn mô tả: 'Before zipping the bag shut, he takes a quick thoughtful browse through his handwritten checklist to verify that nothing vital is missing' (Trước khi kéo khóa ba lô, anh xem lướt qua bản danh sách viết tay để đảm bảo không quên món đồ nào).
